🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: weak sector breadth (4/11) and concentrated leadership with Narrow top performers (4/5 Technology), plus major divergence across large caps where many show 1W vs 1M mismatches — supports a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +9.43% | 1M: +5.76%) ABOVE TREND; Energy strong: VLO (1W: +7.45% | 1M: +23.50%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +10.65%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.37% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.38% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare lagging: SYK (1W: -13.24% | 1M: -20.36%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -14.74% | 1M: -12.32%) BELOW TREND. Communication weak: CHTR (1W: -8.41% | 1M: -12.66%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary soft: BKNG (1W: -11.38% | 1M: -18.53%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -9.32% | 1M: -18.29%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.37% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.38% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +9.43% | 1M: +5.76%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -7.45% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -8.25% | 1M: +2.88%) CORRECTION, CHTR (1W: -8.41% | 1M: -12.66%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -8.98% | 1M: -6.13%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -9.32% | 1M: -18.29%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in higher-multiple Tech/Comm names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.37% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.38% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND. Note Major Divergence: multiple large caps (ETN, AMAT, CAT, BA, V, MA, others) show opposing 1W/1M signals — tactical moves, not clear structural rotation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but active: NVDA (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND, while MSFT (1W: -1.87% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND and AAPL (1W: -3.01% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION — sector 1W +1.03% | 1M -0.74% (24 stocks): internal rotation and narrow leadership.

8. Financials Outlook?
Muted and mixed: JPM (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.42% | 1M: +1.87%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -2.34% | 1M: +0.77%) CORRECTION — sector 1W +0.15% | 1M -1.57% (20 stocks): no clear breakout, watch for follow-through.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Weak overall: AMGN (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -5.67%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.09% | 1M: -8.61%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -1.52% | 1M: +2.52%) CORRECTION — sector 1W -4.04% | 1M -2.05% (17 stocks): defensive names not broadly leading.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to established momentum names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND (INTC, META, AMD) while reducing exposure to structurally weak names in Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary. Style: mixed / no clear Growth vs Value leadership given narrow tech concentration and weak breadth; monitor major divergence before shifting base allocations.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +6.11% | 1M: -10.11%) RECOVERY — watch for follow-through on AI demand. BEARISH: NVS (1W: -14.74% | 1M: -12.32%) BELOW TREND; SYK (1W: -13.24% | 1M: -20.36%) BELOW TREND; PANW (1W: -7.45% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (pockets of strong momentum) and Energy (1W +1.65% | 1M +11.63%) as catalysts persist. BEARISH: Healthcare and Communication (both showing notable negative 1W and negative price action) — watch for downside continuation.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch weekly follow-through for INTC to confirm ABOVE TREND momentum; failure to hold this week’s lows would flag a reversal. META sustaining this week’s breakout would confirm continued momentum; failure to stay above the prior monthly high would signal loss of leadership. AMAT/ETN RECOVERY status needs 1M trend repair for durable confirmation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMAT (+60): Applied Materials bullish on AI demand; AMAT (1W: +6.11% | 1M: -10.11%) RECOVERY — sentiment confirming short-term bounce but 1M remains weak. META (+50): AI agent headlines; META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. ETN (+50): UBS upgrade; ETN (1W: +6.27% | 1M: -6.68%) RECOVERY — short-term rally vs 1M drag.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NVS (-60): Board scrutiny headlines; NVS (1W: -14.74% | 1M: -12.32%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. SYK (-45): supply-chain woes; SYK (1W: -13.24% | 1M: -20.36%) BELOW TREND — confirmed. QCOM (-45): Apple shifting modem mix; QCOM (1W: +6.45% | 1M: +9.37%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging from price, watch for distribution.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear Growth vs Value leadership. INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow Technology leadership and multiple 1W/1M divergences plus headline-driven healthcare weakness (NVS, SYK) — monitor sentiment/flow for confirmation.
